angle_en: Ordinary eyes cannot see the divine form
angle_hi: सामान्य नेत्र दिव्य रूप नहीं देख सकते

en.intro: Arjuna asked to see the cosmic form, and Krishna showed him the universe gathered in his body. But ordinary sight is not enough.
en.notice: Krishna tells Arjuna that he cannot see him with these only, own eyes, and because of that, he gives him divine sight to see his supreme power.
en.next: Sanjaya now tells Dhritarashtra that Krishna revealed the supreme divine form to Arjuna.
en.meaning: You cannot see me with these ordinary eyes. I give you divine sight, so you may behold my supreme power.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने ब्रह्मांड रूप दिखाने को कहा, कृष्ण ने उसे अपने शरीर में सब कुछ दिखाया। पर सामान्य दृष्टि से यह संभव नहीं है।
hi.meaning: परन्तु तू अपनी इस आँख से अर्थात् चर्मचक्षु से मेरे को देख ही नहीं सकता, इसलिए मैं तुझे दिव्य चक्षु देता हूँ, जिससे तू मेरी ईश्वर सम्बन्धी सामर्थ्य को देख।
hi.notice: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि अर्जुन अपने ही नेत्रों से मुझे नहीं देख सकता, और इसलिए वह उसे दिव्य दृष्टि देता है ताकि वह उसकी ऐश्वर्यमय शक्ति को देख सके।
hi.next: संजय अब धृतराष्ट्र को बताते हैं कि कृष्ण ने अर्जुन को अपना परम दिव्य रूप दिखाया।

en.intro: Arjuna asked to see the cosmic form, and Krishna showed him the universe gathered in his body. But ordinary sight is not enough.
en.body: You cannot see me with these ordinary eyes. I give you divine sight, so you may behold my supreme power. Krishna tells Arjuna that he cannot see him with these only, own eyes, and because of that, he gives him divine sight to see his supreme power. Sanjaya now tells Dhritarashtra that Krishna revealed the supreme divine form to Arjuna.
